title: Hearthline AnchorPass Session
description: A short-lived authenticated session established through passkey verification. It stores no biometric data, password, device PIN, private passkey material, or social/discovery data.
$comment: Forbidden fields include password, biometric, faceIdData, touchIdData, fingerprint, devicePin, devicePattern, privateKey, deviceLocation, deviceBehavior, socialGraph, messageContent, profileData, discoveryData, trustScore, safetyScore, riskScore, reputationScore, compatibilityScore, or paidSubscriptionStatus.
